label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: blockers COMPLETE, other edges 3, pool timeouts 115

A.rule: a non-ledger_app session blocked ledger_app sessions in 62 samples; 115 pool acquisition timeouts

report.summary: After the 17:10:00 restart the pool shrank from 10 connections/30 s timeout to 3/250 ms. Pool acquisition timeouts followed, with 500/503 errors and slow transfers. An idle-in-transaction session blocking writers likely worsened it.

findings.claim: Config change at the 17:10:00 restart cut poolMaximumSize 10→3 and connection timeout 30000→250 ms.
findings.reason: Runtime config shows the changed pool settings in effect from 17:10:00.

findings.claim: The small pool exhausted: 115 acquisition timeouts, active hit the max of 3, and pending borrowers appeared.
findings.reason: Pool metrics show timeouts and saturation from 17:10:03 onward, matching the restart.

findings.claim: Transfers show 107 HTTP 500s and 85 503s (29% server errors), p95 2.4 s and p99 4.4 s, consistent with pool timeouts.
findings.reason: Error and slow-request counts are close to the timeout count, but no direct request-to-timeout link was observed.

findings.claim: Session 74565, idle in transaction, blocked ledger_app sessions for up to 1.97 s, which likely held the 3 connections longer and worsened exhaustion.
findings.reason: Blocking began at 17:10:04, right after the pool shrank, so each wait ties up a scarce connection.

findings.claim: The outbox and consumer delivery are healthy and are not the cause.
findings.reason: 478 deliveries all succeeded in about 72 ms, arrivals match publications, and failed is 0.

limitations: Scrapes have a 10 s gap at 17:09:53–17:10:03, and the two counter restarts blur before/after comparison.
Blocker sampling is every 2 s, and the source of the idle-in-transaction session 74565 is unknown.
E1 (get_request_metrics) is PARTIAL: Scrapes are missing for 10 s of the window (1 gap(s)); values there are unknown, not zero.
E2 (get_outbox_stats) is PARTIAL: Scrapes are missing for 10 s of the window (1 gap(s)); values there are unknown, not zero.
E5 (get_pool_metrics) is PARTIAL: Scrapes are missing for 10 s of the window (1 gap(s)); values there are unknown, not zero.
next_checks: Identify what session 74565 is and why it stays idle in transaction.
Restore the pool to 10 connections/30 s timeout and check whether the 500/503s stop.

alternatives.reason: Blocking appears only after 17:10:04 and waits are under 2 s. With the old 30 s timeout and 10 connections, the pool would likely have absorbed them.
alternatives.hypothesis: Idle-in-transaction blocker alone caused the failures, independent of pool size.

alternatives.reason: All deliveries succeeded at about 72 ms with no errors.
